description.narrative: IPA's contribution to the scope of work of MIT / JPAL’s Humanitarian Protection Initiative will include a focus on project development efforts. IPA’s Peace & Recovery Program will lead project development efforts in collaboration with IPA Country Offices in FCDO priority countries for humanitarian assistance. IPA will also support writing and communications on HPI’s launch, RFP advertisement to Low and Middle-Income Country (LMIC) researchers and promising implementing partners, implementation challenges and best practices on field research in humanitarian settings, and support policy outreach regarding intermediary and final outputs of the research
